name: specadoc
description: Explicit engineering lifecycle (explore, propose, apply, archive) with bounded scout, worker, and reviewer roles and deterministic artifact gates.

interface.shortDescription: Explicit engineering lifecycle and standalone engineering companions
interface.longDescription: Explore, propose, apply and compactly archive changes. Includes optional tidy, codebase-design and domain-modeling skills. Roles use project profiles or portable dispatch contracts; no automatic host configuration.
defaultPrompt: Use specadoc explore to investigate a proposed change.
